description: Keller Town Center is a premier community shopping destination strategically located on a major thoroughfare in Keller, Texas, serving one of the most affluent markets in the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. Anchored by Tom Thumb, this 120,279 square foot center has established itself as a vital retail hub for the surrounding neighborhoods, attracting nearly 2 million visits annually. The center is surrounded by dynamic residential communities where average household incomes exceed $200,000 and home values approach $590,000, creating a sophisticated customer base that values quality and convenience. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized leader in community-centered retail, Keller Town Center offers a carefully curated mix of retailers, restaurants, salons, medical spaces, and fitness facilities that cater to the daily needs and lifestyle preferences of its discerning clientele. With its prime location, strong anchor tenant, and access to one of Texas's most desirable demographic profiles, Keller Town Center continues to thrive as an essential shopping and service destination in the North Texas market.
